summary: Axia Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a Share Purchase Agreement with GEBBRAS Participações Ltda. for the sale of its entire 49% minority stake in four electric transmission SPEs. The consideration is BRL 451.5 million in cash. The SPEs hold ~1,086 km of transmission lines with concessions through 2039-2040, estimated 2027 net revenue of BRL 218 million and EBITDA of BRL 176 million, and net debt of BRL 414 million in 2025. Closing is subject to customary conditions. The divestiture aligns with Axia's strategic plan to optimize minority interests and simplify corporate structure. Watch for regulatory approvals and any adjustments.
